events.title: Turkey trot prime
events.text: The Thanksgiving 10k. Your age group is winnable.

effects.tpl: You place second. The pie has never tasted better.
Costume division, high fives, zero regrets.

events.title: Tin decade
events.text: Ten years married. The gift is tin. The marriage is steel.

effects.tpl: Two days, no kids, old jokes. The spark files no paperwork.
Backyard vows, same promises, deeper meanings.

events.title: Attic archaeology
events.text: The attic yields your childhood box, sealed with stickers.

effects.tpl: Trophies, notes, bad hair. The kids howl with joy.
A new capsule sealed for 2046. The future thanks you.

events.title: Sitter network
events.text: Date nights die without sitters. A network must be built.

effects.tpl: Three trusted sitters. Date night: resurrected.
You watch theirs, they watch yours. Free and trusted.

events.title: Fence diplomacy
events.text: The fence leans. The neighbor suggests splitting the bill.

effects.tpl: New cedar, shared cost, better neighbors.
You build it straight. Pride in every post.

events.title: Indoor pool
events.text: The basement floods at 2am. The shop-vac is ready.

effects.tpl: Drains and pump installed. Never again, says the warranty.
Fans for a week, bleach, vigilance. Saved for 400 dollars.

events.title: Iron basement
events.text: A rack, a bench, a bar. The commute is stairs.

effects.tpl: Used iron, new habits. Training happens daily now.
Pushups and pullups. Free, brutal, effective.

events.title: Block captain
events.text: The block party needs a captain. The grill is big enough.

effects.tpl: Bounce house, band, pie contest. Best party in years.
Two hundred burgers, zero leftovers. Your apron is famous.

events.title: Chapter and verse
events.text: The neighborhood book club has opinions and excellent snacks.

effects.tpl: You connect the themes. The group upgrades its picks.
Your spread becomes legend. Attendance triples.

events.title: Cabin math
events.text: A cabin timeshare with friends: twelve weekends a year.

effects.tpl: Lake mornings, pine air, kids who vanish into woods. Worth it.
Two rented weeks, zero upkeep. Flexibility wins.

events.title: Camp week
events.text: School camp needs chaperones. Sleeping bags required.

effects.tpl: Canoes, stars, homesickness cured. Your kid brags about you.
Legendary snack trunk. Every kid knows your name.

events.title: Second car math
events.text: Activities scatter across town. One car cannot be two places.

effects.tpl: Used, reliable, scheduled like an airline. Chaos: managed.
Three families rotate. Costs split, friendships sealed.

events.title: Pivot at 35
events.text: Your industry shifts. Retrain or double down?

then.tpl: Certified in the new stack. 9,000 dollars raise follows.

else.tpl: Halfway skilled, fully employable. The pivot continues.

effects.tpl: Depth beats novelty. Your expertise premium grows.

events.title: Choir risers
events.text: The community choir needs tenors. You hum in the car.

effects.tpl: Second row, swaying gently. The holiday concert moves hundreds.
Risers built, robes steamed. The music stands on you.

events.title: Lab results
events.text: The labs flag cholesterol. The doctor suggests boring miracles.

effects.tpl: Thirty minutes daily. Numbers fall within months.
Oats, beans, fish. The palate adapts; arteries applaud.

events.title: Press day
events.text: A neighbor's press sits idle. Apples are falling everywhere.

effects.tpl: Forty gallons pressed. The neighborhood drinks fall.
Ten gallons of your own. Cider: endless.

events.title: 529 day
events.text: The college fund opens with a hundred dollars and big dreams.

effects.tpl: Monthly transfers hum. Compounding starts its long work.
Grandparents match gifts. The fund doubles its pace.

events.title: Gray muzzle
events.text: The dog slows on stairs. The vet talks about comfort.

effects.tpl: Ramps, soft beds, slow walks. Every day counts double.
Pip arrives. The old dog teaches, the young one learns.

events.title: Pro training
events.text: The dog pulls like a sled team. A trainer offers six weeks.

effects.tpl: Loose-leash walking achieved. Walks become joy again.
Treat timing mastered free. The dog graduates anyway.

events.title: Board game pact
events.text: Monthly game night needs a host with a big table.

effects.tpl: Five years running. The trophy is a golden meeple.
Season brackets, playoffs, a champion crowned in April.

events.title: Cabin unplugged
events.text: No kids, no signal, one cabin. The marriage needs a weekend.

effects.tpl: Books, baths, long talks. You return fluent in each other.
Kayaks and ridges. Tired, sunburnt, reconnected.

events.title: Grown-up camp
events.text: Adult summer camp: archery, crafts, no kids allowed.

effects.tpl: Capture the flag at 38 hits different. Gloriously.
Your whittling class fills twice. Camp legend.

events.title: Fence gallery
events.text: The back fence begs for color. The HOA allows murals.

effects.tpl: Four seasons, forty feet. Walkers stop daily.
Handprints border the masterpiece. Imperfect, perfect.

events.title: Friend's split
events.text: Your best friend's marriage ends. They need a couch and ears.

effects.tpl: You listen for months. The friendship deepens through the wreck.
Every invite extended. Loneliness never gets a foothold.

events.title: Dad band
events.text: Three parents, one garage, Wednesday nights.

effects.tpl: The town fair stage. Kids mortified, crowd delighted.
One song, properly recorded. Played at every barbecue forever.

events.title: Project car
events.text: A 1989 convertible needs everything. The price is almost free.

effects.tpl: Three years of weekends. First drive: top down, tears up.
Cleaned, listed, sold. 400 dollars for the effort.

events.title: Real garden
events.text: The yard becomes a quarter-acre of intent.

effects.tpl: Salads from steps away. The grocery bill shrinks.
Three fruit trees planted. Future pies secured.

events.title: Mystery ache
events.text: Something twinges when you lift. Google suggests seven disasters.

effects.tpl: Minor strain, real plan. Caught early, fixed fast.
Lighter weights, walks, sleep. The body thanks you.

events.title: Summit Sundays
events.text: A hiking group meets Sundays. The peaks are calling.

effects.tpl: Twelve summits this year. Legs: forged. Views: banked.
You sweep the slow group. Three finish their first peak.

events.title: Raise routing
events.text: The raise lands. Lifestyle or portfolio?

effects.tpl: The whole raise vanishes into investments. Future-you cheers.
Half invested, half enjoyed. Balance compounds too.

events.title: Kitchen era
events.text: The kitchen is 1994. The quotes are 2026.

effects.tpl: Cabinets refaced, island added. Home value jumps.
Paint, handles, light. It looks new for 800 dollars.

events.title: Second language
events.text: The job rewards bilingual pay. Your high school Spanish stirs.

effects.tpl: Conversational by spring. The pay bump follows.
400-day streak. Ordering food becomes a party trick.

events.title: Lunchbox notes
events.text: Your kid trades lunches daily. Notes might fix the menu.

effects.tpl: Jokes and hearts in every box. Trades drop 90 percent.
Bento era begins. Other kids offer trades again.

events.title: Relay team
events.text: Work forms a marathon relay. Your leg is 10k.

effects.tpl: You run it in 48 minutes. The team places third.
Signs, cowbell, splits called. The team runs on you.

events.title: Give back
events.text: Juniors ask for your time. Calendars are full; meaning calls.

effects.tpl: Two careers bend upward because of your hours.
Your playbook helps hundreds. Leverage of kindness.

events.title: The third row
events.text: Two kids, one sedan, zero space. The minivan looms.

effects.tpl: Sliding doors change everything. Resistance was futile.
Roof box buys two years. The van waits patiently.

events.title: Shared driveway
events.text: The shared driveway cracks. Both houses, one bill.

effects.tpl: Split cost, one contractor, done in three days.
Your half smooths out. Their half can wait its turn.

events.title: Fruit share
events.text: A farm share delivers weekly boxes of the season.

effects.tpl: Berries, corn, tomatoes. Cooking follows the harvest.
Abundance weekly. Neighbors get the overflow.

events.title: Conference season
events.text: The teacher says your kid is bright but distractible. Familiar.

effects.tpl: Homework hour, same time daily. Grades climb within weeks.
The art is incredible. You frame the focus issue as fuel.

events.title: Patio season
events.text: The backyard is mud. The dream is string lights and smoke.

effects.tpl: Deck, lights, grill. Summers move outside permanently.
One fire pit, infinite nights. Best 300 dollars spent.

events.title: Statement season
events.text: The retirement statement arrives. The number is real now.

effects.tpl: Two percent more vanishes monthly. Compounding nods.
A side account opens. Options multiply quietly.

events.title: Keys again
events.text: The childhood piano follows you as inheritance. It waits.

effects.tpl: Scales return like old friends. Recital by spring.
The kids take lessons on it. The house fills with practice.

events.title: Dink league
events.text: The rec league needs a sub. The paddle is provided.

effects.tpl: You start by playoffs. The kitchen is your kingdom.
Third-shot drops mastered. Partners request you.

events.title: Charity cards
events.text: A charity poker night: 50 dollars in, glory out.

then.tpl: Final table! 400 dollars and a trophy that shines.

else.tpl: Out by nine. The cause still wins. You deal the final.

effects.tpl: Best dealer in town. The night runs clean and rich.

events.title: Director track
events.text: The director role opens. Two years of work distill to one interview.

then.tpl: The role is yours. 12,000 dollars more and a bigger blast radius.

else.tpl: An outsider gets it. Your packet was strong; next cycle is yours.

effects.tpl: You deepen instead of climbing. The craft pays quietly.

events.title: Bucket race
events.text: A sprint triathlon: swim, bike, run, glory.

effects.tpl: You finish mid-pack, grinning like a champion.
You swim the leg. The team handles the rest. Shared glory.

events.title: Covered porch
events.text: Rain cancels porch season. A cover would fix everything.

effects.tpl: Covered porch, all seasons. Rain becomes ambiance.
Shade sails angle the storms away. Good enough glows.

events.title: One more show
events.text: The old band reunites for one show. Practice starts Tuesday.

effects.tpl: Sold out local hall. You play like it is 2009.
Filmed forever. The group chat replays it monthly.

events.title: Roof o'clock
events.text: The roof has five years, says the inspector. Or one storm.

effects.tpl: New roof, warranty, peace through every storm.
Patches hold. The fund grows for the full job.

events.title: Month off?
events.text: Six years in. A month unpaid could reset everything.

effects.tpl: Trails, books, naps. You return a new person to the same desk.
Summer Fridays off instead. Small resets, steady gains.

events.title: Auction night
events.text: The school auction needs items. Your closet holds donations.

effects.tpl: Your grill pan package funds three field trips.
You close the books at midnight. The PTA loves you.

events.title: Nights to days?
events.text: The side business covers half your salary. Leap or steady?

then.tpl: It works! Full-time freedom and 20,000 dollars ahead.

else.tpl: Lean year, lessons learned. The job takes you back kindly.

effects.tpl: Both engines run. 8,000 dollars extra, zero risk.

events.title: Snore report
events.text: Your partner reports freight-train snoring. A study is suggested.

effects.tpl: Mild apnea, simple fix. Energy returns like youth.
Pillows arranged like architecture. Snoring halves.

events.title: Sideline era
events.text: Saturday means four games across two towns.

effects.tpl: You coach the U10s. Orange slices and glory.
Goals set up, benches hauled. The league runs on parents like you.

events.title: Starter culture
events.text: Everyone has a starter named Doughbi-Wan. Yours arrives.

effects.tpl: Crusts crackle. The house smells like a bakery.
Splits for five friends. The culture spreads literally.

events.title: Borrow, don't buy
events.text: The tool library opens: 500 tools, one card.

effects.tpl: Borrowed saws, owned results. Deck done for 900 dollars.
Fix-it nights monthly. Toasters live because of you.

events.title: Real trip
events.text: The kids are old enough to remember. One big trip.

effects.tpl: Geysers, canyons, junior ranger badges. They will remember.
One beach, one week, infinite sand. Simple wins.

events.title: Treehouse 2.0
events.text: The kids want a treehouse with windows. Real windows.

effects.tpl: Insulated, wired, legendary. The kids move in emotionally.
Weekend kit, striped curtains. Joy: identical.

events.title: Tuesday trivia
events.text: The pub quiz has a dynasty team to dethrone.

then.tpl: Champions! 250 dollars bar credit and a plaque.

else.tpl: Second by one point. The rematch simmers all year.

effects.tpl: Your music round goes legendary. The pub begs for encores.

events.title: Coach the strugglers
events.text: A kid on the team fails math. You were that kid.

effects.tpl: C to B+ by spring. The kid's mom cries at you.
You fund a pro tutor. The kid passes; the team keeps its star.

events.title: Paperwork of love
events.text: No will, two kids, one dog. The lawyer waits.

effects.tpl: Wills, guardians, trusts. The family is protected. Sleep improves.
Basic documents filed. Better than nothing, upgrade later.
